name: ledger
doc:
Package ledger takes, pays, ships and cancels customer orders. It keeps its orders as values in a
map and its events in a slice the caller drains after each call: no channel, no goroutine and no
pointer shared between owners.

types.name: Event
types.doc: Event is one change of the ledger. Kind names it; the fields it does not use are empty.

funcs.name: PendingOrders
funcs.doc: PendingOrders lists the pending orders in map order, which is random; the caller sorts them.

funcs.name: Drain
funcs.doc: Drain returns the events since the last Drain, oldest first, and forgets them.
